P3-GAP-001.title: Sale Line Items Lack Barcode / SKU Point-in-Time Snapshot
P3-GAP-001.current_behavior: When a sale item is created, only product_id, quantity, unit_price, subtotal, and cost_price are stored. The barcode and SKU are resolved at render time via products relationship.
P3-GAP-001.broken_handoff: Product Master -> Sale Items Historical Snapshot
P3-GAP-001.business_impact: If a product barcode or SKU changes in product master, past printed invoices and reprint historical records show altered or missing barcodes.
P3-GAP-001.financial_impact: None directly on totals; impacts audit and inventory dispute resolution.
P3-GAP-001.inventory_impact: Prevents precise reverse-lookup of serialized/barcoded units from historical sale item lines.
P3-GAP-001.customer_supplier_impact: Customer invoice reprints may diverge from original printed receipt.

P3-GAP-002.title: Changing Customer on Posted Sale Creates Khata Receivable Discrepancy
P3-GAP-002.current_behavior: When an existing sale is edited via PUT /api/v1/sales/{id} and customer_id is modified, the sale table customer_id updates, but the previous customer Khata transaction is not credited and the new customer Khata is not debited.
P3-GAP-002.broken_handoff: Sale Mutation -> Khata Transaction Reversal & Re-posting
P3-GAP-002.business_impact: Original customer statement permanently reflects unpaid charge; new customer statement omits the debt.
P3-GAP-002.financial_impact: Severe AR ledger divergence between customers.balance cache and individual customer statement transaction totals.
P3-GAP-002.customer_supplier_impact: Customer billed for items purchased by another customer.

P3-GAP-003.title: Split-Tender Payment Method Allocations Lack Dedicated Breakdown Table
P3-GAP-003.current_behavior: When a sale is paid via multiple tenders (e.g., 50% Cash, 50% Bank Card), the sale header records payment_method="split" and paid_amount=total, but does not store child payment ledger rows linking exact tender amounts to specific financial accounts.
P3-GAP-003.broken_handoff: POS Multi-Tender Modal -> Financial Account Breakdown Persistence
P3-GAP-003.business_impact: Inability to reconcile end-of-day bank settlement vs cash drawer totals for split payments; receipt reprints cannot show tender breakdown.
P3-GAP-003.financial_impact: Cash register drawer and bank account reconciliation reports cannot independently verify split payment allocations.
P3-GAP-003.customer_supplier_impact: Customer cannot obtain itemized payment receipt showing split card vs cash amounts.

P3-GAP-004.title: Offline POS Batch Sync Relies on Client Timestamps Without Clock Drift Guard
P3-GAP-004.current_behavior: When offline sales sync via POST /api/v1/sync/sales, created_at is adopted directly from client device without bounds check against server time or sequence ordering.
P3-GAP-004.broken_handoff: Offline Device Sync Engine -> Server Inventory Movement Chronology
P3-GAP-004.business_impact: Device with incorrect local clock injects transactions out of chronological order into inventory and cash movements.
P3-GAP-004.financial_impact: Shift cash reporting and daily revenue aggregates become distorted across calendar days.
P3-GAP-004.inventory_impact: Negative inventory movement timestamps may precede stock receipt timestamp in stock ledger.
P3-GAP-004.customer_supplier_impact: Invoices generated offline appear with incorrect dates.

P3-GAP-005.title: Purchase Freight & Landed Cost Not Allocated to Product Cost Moving Average
P3-GAP-005.current_behavior: Purchase bills support shipping_cost / freight fields on the purchase header, but InventoryService calculates unit cost strictly from purchase_items.unit_cost, omitting freight allocation.
P3-GAP-005.broken_handoff: Purchase Bill Header -> Product Moving Average Unit Cost Calculation
P3-GAP-005.business_impact: Gross profit margins are artificially overstated because COGS excludes inbound shipping and freight costs.
P3-GAP-005.financial_impact: Distorts inventory valuation on balance sheet and miscalculates FIFO/weighted average COGS in P&L.
P3-GAP-005.inventory_impact: Product cost price remains lower than true landed acquisition cost.
P3-GAP-005.customer_supplier_impact: Pricing decisions made on underestimated unit cost leading to eroded retail margins.

P3-GAP-006.title: Missing Dedicated Supplier Return / Debit Note Workflow
P3-GAP-006.current_behavior: HBOS does not have a dedicated Purchase Return / Supplier Return entity. To return damaged or excess stock to a supplier, operators must manually adjust inventory down and enter a separate AP adjustment.
P3-GAP-006.broken_handoff: Procurement Correction -> Supplier Debit Note & Stock Decrement Orchestration
P3-GAP-006.business_impact: Increases operator error when returning defective stock to vendors; no formal debit note document generated.
P3-GAP-006.financial_impact: Supplier payable balances frequently fail to reflect returned merchandise credits.
P3-GAP-006.inventory_impact: Manual stock adjustments used as workaround obscure procurement defect rate analytics.
P3-GAP-006.customer_supplier_impact: Disputes with suppliers over uncredited returned goods.

P3-GAP-007.title: Supplier Payment Mutation Lacks Dedicated Automated Reversal Path
P3-GAP-007.current_behavior: When a supplier payment is recorded via POST /api/v1/suppliers/{id}/payments, no DELETE /reversal endpoint exists to automatically restore supplier AP and credit the financial account simultaneously.
P3-GAP-007.broken_handoff: Supplier Payment Ledger -> Automated Reversal Compensation Chain
P3-GAP-007.business_impact: Erroneous supplier payment entries require manual dual-sided database/account corrections.
P3-GAP-007.financial_impact: Risk of one-sided corrections causing bank account and supplier ledger mismatch.
P3-GAP-007.customer_supplier_impact: Supplier ledger shows incorrect payment history upon erroneous disbursement.

P3-GAP-008.title: Sale Return Lacks Granular Restock Condition / Scrap Decision Flag
P3-GAP-008.current_behavior: Sale returns automatically increment branch stock unconditionally for all returned line items. There is no flag to mark an item as damaged/scrap to prevent re-entering sellable inventory.
P3-GAP-008.broken_handoff: Sale Return Modal -> Damaged Goods Quarantine / Scrap Ledger
P3-GAP-008.business_impact: Damaged/expired goods returned by customers are immediately added back into sellable inventory on hand.
P3-GAP-008.financial_impact: Overvalues sellable inventory assets by carrying unsellable damaged goods at full cost price.
P3-GAP-008.inventory_impact: Inventory on hand includes broken units; POS operators can sell defective items to subsequent customers.
P3-GAP-008.customer_supplier_impact: Subsequent customers may receive returned damaged merchandise.

P3-GAP-009.title: Purchase Cancellation Does Not Verify If Received Stock Has Already Been Sold
P3-GAP-009.current_behavior: Canceling a received purchase attempts to decrement branch inventory by the full purchase quantity. If items have already been sold via POS, quantity_on_hand is forced into negative numbers without pre-check.
P3-GAP-009.broken_handoff: Purchase Cancellation Service -> Current Available Stock Guard
P3-GAP-009.business_impact: Canceling historical purchases corrupts stock balances into negative quantities.
P3-GAP-009.financial_impact: AP reversed while revenue from sold stock remains recognized, distorting matching principle.
P3-GAP-009.inventory_impact: Creates negative quantity_on_hand records in branch_inventories.
P3-GAP-009.customer_supplier_impact: Supplier AP canceled for inventory that was consumed in retail operations.

P3-GAP-010.title: Sale Cancellation Incomplete Reversal When Sale Is Partially Paid by Bank Transfer
P3-GAP-010.current_behavior: Sale cancellation successfully reverses cash register inflow and customer Khata, but if the sale was settled via bank transfer, the corresponding financial account balance is not decremented automatically.
P3-GAP-010.broken_handoff: Sale Cancellation Service -> Financial Account Reversal Movement
P3-GAP-010.business_impact: Bank balance in system remains inflated after a bank-paid sale is voided.
P3-GAP-010.financial_impact: Financial account balance does not match real-world bank statement upon sale void.
P3-GAP-010.customer_supplier_impact: Customer was refunded in reality but financial account ledger shows funds retained.

P3-GAP-011.title: Stock Quantity Adjustment Bypasses Financial Inventory Valuation Adjustment Account
P3-GAP-011.current_behavior: Stock adjustments increment or decrement branch inventory and record an inventory_movement, but do not post a corresponding debit/credit entry to a Financial Inventory Shrinkage / Gain account.
P3-GAP-011.broken_handoff: Inventory Adjustment -> Financial Account P&L Shrinkage Write-off
P3-GAP-011.business_impact: Physical inventory write-offs do not automatically reflect in financial P&L statements.
P3-GAP-011.financial_impact: Inventory shrinkage expenses must be manually entered as separate expense records.
P3-GAP-011.inventory_impact: Physical stock aligns with records, but financial asset balance drifts from ledger.

P3-GAP-012.title: Inter-Branch Stock Transfer Operates Synchronously Without In-Transit Clearing State
P3-GAP-012.current_behavior: Inter-branch transfer immediately decrements sending branch stock and increments destination branch stock in a single transaction without a pending/in-transit intermediate status.
P3-GAP-012.broken_handoff: Sending Branch Dispatch -> Transit Verification -> Receiving Branch Receipt
P3-GAP-012.business_impact: Goods in transit are immediately visible as available to sell at destination branch before physical arrival; loss during transit cannot be tracked.
P3-GAP-012.financial_impact: Branch-level inventory valuation immediately shifts before custody transfer is confirmed.
P3-GAP-012.inventory_impact: Destination branch POS operators can sell stock that is still physically in transit on a delivery truck.
P3-GAP-012.customer_supplier_impact: POS orders at receiving branch fail fulfillment if truck has not arrived.

P3-GAP-013.title: Operating Expense Entry Allows Null Financial Account Creating Unallocated Cash Drift
P3-GAP-013.current_behavior: Expense creation allows financial_account_id to be null when marked as cash without enforcing an active cash register session link.
P3-GAP-013.broken_handoff: Expense Disbursal -> Cash Register / Financial Account Exact Allocation
P3-GAP-013.business_impact: Expense records exist with no deduction from either cash drawer or bank accounts.
P3-GAP-013.financial_impact: P&L reflects expense but balance sheet cash/bank accounts remain overvalued.

P3-GAP-014.title: Customer Wholesale Price Tier Bypass During POS Offline Cart Add
P3-GAP-014.current_behavior: When POS operates offline, wholesale customer pricing tier is not applied dynamically if customer is attached after cart lines are already added.
P3-GAP-014.broken_handoff: Customer Profile Wholesale Flag -> Offline Reactive Cart Price Recalculation
P3-GAP-014.business_impact: Wholesale customers charged retail price on offline transactions unless operator manually overrides each line.
P3-GAP-014.financial_impact: Customer overcharged; requires credit adjustments and manual invoice corrections.
P3-GAP-014.customer_supplier_impact: Wholesale clients dispute incorrect retail pricing on offline sales.

P3-GAP-015.title: Customer Payment Reversal Does Not Guard Against Secondary Over-Collection Reversal
P3-GAP-015.current_behavior: Reversing a customer payment restores the customer balance, but does not verify if subsequent payments or credits have already settled the original sale invoice.
P3-GAP-015.broken_handoff: Customer Payment Reversal -> Invoice Level Due Amount Re-allocation
P3-GAP-015.business_impact: Customer balance increases, but individual sale payment statuses may remain marked as PAID.
P3-GAP-015.financial_impact: Discrepancy between customer total balance and sum of unpaid sales invoices.
P3-GAP-015.customer_supplier_impact: Customer account shows debt while specific invoices indicate settled.
